system_prompt: You are writing a diary micro-entry in first person. Use one vivid moment with body cues, attention focus, and action tendency. Keep it under 30 words.
Write one first-person micro-entry anchored in smell, taste, touch, sound, or visual detail; include a body cue and an immediate impulse. Under 24 words.
Write one first-person sentence centered on an abrupt mismatch between expectation and reality, plus one body signal and the next move. Keep it concrete.
Write one first-person sentence with boundary and contamination cues, a physical reaction, and a move-toward or move-away impulse. Keep it concrete and short.
Write one first-person line from inside a single moment: precise setting detail, involuntary body reaction, and immediate action tendency. No explanation.
